notes: Shopify storefront, robots.txt allows crawling (no Claude-specific disallow; UCP/MCP catalog endpoint offered but not needed). Accessed entirely via Chrome tab same-origin fetch() from the loaded page context (no curl/proxy). Reached the full mega-menu via the homepage HTML's data-parentCategory/data-childCategory attributes on nav <a> tags, and cross-checked against the full /collections.json?limit=250 listing (paginated to page 6, total 1238 collections site-wide) keyword-scanned for furniture terms (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelf, bookcase, seating, nightstand, lounge, outdoor/patio/garden, kids/nursery, etc.). Two genuine furniture nodes exist, both flat/leaf (self-named header+link, same pattern as this company's Glassware/Mirrors nodes in the prior Home-Decor pass): (1) 'Furniture' is its own top-level mega-menu column under 'Home' containing a single link /collections/furniture -- 22 items, all genuinely furniture (side tables, dining/lounge/arm chairs, a bed, sofas incl. one sectional, a bench, a pouf, center tables, a cabinet, a high chair, a bar trolley); qty corroborated twice: rendered header '22 Items' on the collection page = /collections/furniture/products.json?limit=250 enumeration (22) = independent tag-collection /collections/all/Filterclass_Furniture rendered header '22 Items'. (2) 'Bar Furniture' (/collections/bar-furniture) sits in the site's own taxonomy as a child of the 'Barware' mega-menu column (data-childCategory="Barware"), not of 'Furniture' -- so per the top-bucket rule (site puts it under a differently-named, more truthful department) it is emitted with category="Bar Furniture" rather than folded into "Furniture". 3 items, all genuine furniture (a cabinet, a bar trolley, a high chair); qty corroborated: rendered header '3 Items' = /collections/bar-furniture/products.json?limit=250 enumeration (3). All 3 Bar Furniture products are also members of the 22-item Furniture collection (a normal cross-listing between the general Furniture department and the use-case Barware department, not a duplicate-link defect -- the two collections have distinct URLs and distinct site-reported counts) -- kept both rows since the site itself presents them as two separate real nav destinations. Sanity-checked invalid/decoy tag collections (Filterclass_Sofa, _Chair, _Table, _Bed) all silently 200'd to the site-wide fallback count (2274 items) confirming they are non-existent tags, not real furniture buckets -- excluded per the 'bad slug serves a plausible wrong number' trap. No Living Room / Bedroom / Dining / Office / Outdoor / Kids furniture departments exist anywhere in the nav or the 1238-collection sitemap; Nicobar's furniture assortment is a small, deliberately curated capsule (mostly a 'THOT x Nico Sanctuary' collaboration plus a 'Contours of Time' line), not a broad furniture catalogue. Excluded per scope: Bedding/Bedcover & Throws/Bedding & Cushions (textile), Table Linen (textile), Bar Tools/Bar Glasses/Decanters (barware, non-furniture), all marketing roll-ups (New Arrivals, Bestsellers, Nico Core, All Home, All Collections, Rakhi, Best of Nicobar Gifts, THE Gift Shop, etc.), and 'MOHENJO LOUNGE' / 'Dining Collection Zanzibar' (product collaboration/marketing collections per Section 3, not real furniture sub-categories -- neither appears in the nav at all).
